observations: A single photo showing a right-hand side (RHS) car headlamp.
The headlamp features a projector lens and a clear outer lens.
There is a prominent amber reflector/indicator on the outer edge.
A white light strip (likely LED) runs along the bottom interior edge.
The lens surface appears cloudy or has fine surface scratches.
The photo has a 'PUREGOLD GLOBAL' watermark.
The item is resting on dirt/ground with debris in the background.
No manufacturer branding or part numbers are visible on the front.

No Toyota branding is visible; the design resembles an Acura TL more than common Toyota models.
Verification requires a photo of the manufacturer stamps on the rear housing.
The lens is cloudy and scuffed, which can hide fine cracks; a close-up or back-lit shot is needed.
The rear of the headlamp, where mounting clips are located, is not shown.

response.reason: The seller's text is contradictory, claiming the part is for Hyundai/Kia and then Toyota. Visually, the part resembles an Acura TL headlamp, which is not represented in the seller's text. Without a part number or a view of the mounting clips, it is impossible to confirm the vehicle application or condition.
